name: discriminated-union-implementation
details: Implement discriminated union schema for memory tool using low-level Server API instead of McpServer.registerTool(). This will provide proper JSON Schema with oneOf and exact required fields per command variant.

tasks.name: Create schemas.ts
tasks.details: Create src/memory/schemas.ts with discriminated union for all 6 memory commands. Each command gets its own schema with exact required fields. Export MemoryCommand type and assertNever helper.

tasks.name: Create command-executor.ts
tasks.details: Create src/memory/command-executor.ts with type-safe dispatch switch statement. Uses discriminated union for automatic type narrowing per command variant.

tasks.name: Refactor mcp-server.ts
tasks.details: Replace McpServer with low-level Server API. Manually register ListToolsRequestSchema and CallToolRequestSchema handlers. Use zodToJsonSchema to convert discriminated union to proper oneOf JSON Schema.

tasks.name: Update operations.ts
tasks.details: Update MemoryOperations method signatures to accept discriminated union command objects directly instead of extracting from params. Remove manual command string switches.

tasks.name: Update transports.ts
tasks.details: Update transport initialization to work with Server instead of McpServer. Change type annotations and ensure server.connect() calls work correctly.

tasks.name: Update index.ts
tasks.details: Update entry point to import and use the new createMemoryServer function. Ensure all config passing works correctly.

tasks.name: Build and test
tasks.details: Run npm run build to compile TypeScript. Fix any compilation errors. Verify dist/ output is correct.

tasks.name: Test with Claude Code
tasks.details: Test the MCP server with actual Claude Code instance via .mcp.json integration. Verify JSON Schema shows proper oneOf structure. Test each command variant.
